records.source: A SUGGESTION IS JUDGED, NOT RELABELLED (item 512). A crop Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the key legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. See :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` and :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.

A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the structured-data name legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. records.translation: UNA SUGERENCIA SE JUZGA, NO SE REETIQUETA (elemento 512). Un recorte para el que Suggest propuso una clase lleva una insignia ámbar ``?`` junto a su anillo discontinuo. Un clic o ``Y`` la confirma (pasa a ser una etiqueta normal y lleva una marca verde); un clic derecho o ``N`` la rechaza (vuelve a quedar sin respuesta y lleva una cruz roja); ``U`` deshace cualquiera de las dos. Cada juicio se escribe en la columna ``<column>_verdict`` como ``+c`` o ``-c``, de modo que sobrevive a un reinicio, y a la siguiente ronda de Suggest se le entregan los rechazos para entrenar. records.source: A recycled id -- the same number given to an unrelated object after the first one left -- is the defect the whole plan is exposed to, and it looks exactly like a tracking gap from one frame. What separates them is distance: a real object that was missed for a frame is found again near where it was, and usually still overlapping its own mask. So each gap is reported with the distance covered per missing frame, the overlap between the mask before the gap and the mask after it, and the distance a continuous object in the same data covers in one frame.
records.context: A recycled id -- the same number given to an unrelated object after the first one left -- is the defect the whole plan is exposed to, and it looks exactly like a tracking gap from one frame. What separates them is distance: a real object that was missed for a frame is found again near where it was, and usually still overlapping its own mask. So each gap is reported with the distance covered per missing frame, the overlap between the mask before the gap and the mask after it, and the distance a continuous object in the same data covers in one frame.
records.translation: Un id reciclado -- el mismo número asignado a un objeto no relacionado después de que el primero se haya ido -- es el defecto al que está expuesto todo el plan, y tiene exactamente el mismo aspecto que un hueco de seguimiento de un fotograma. Lo que los distingue es la distancia: un objeto real que no se detectó en un fotograma vuelve a encontrarse cerca de donde estaba y normalmente todavía solapa con su propia máscara. Por eso cada hueco se notifica con la distancia recorrida por fotograma ausente, el solapamiento entre la máscara anterior al hueco y la máscara posterior, y la distancia que recorre en un fotograma un objeto continuo en los mismos datos.
